stories.title: WVU retires record-setting QB White's No. 5 jersey
stories.summary: Pat White's record-setting career at West Virginia two decades ago came full circle when the school retired his No. 5 jersey.

stories.title: Mad hatter: Cards manager tossed after cap flap
stories.summary: Cardinals manager Oliver Marmol was ejected from Friday's win shortly after St. Louis rookie reliever Hancel Rincon, who was making his major league debut, was told to straighten his hat.

stories.title: Qinwen, Potapova spring pair of US Open upsets
stories.summary: Zheng Qinwen rallied past Madison Keys and Anastasia Potapova ousted Amanda Anisimova in a pair of high-profile upsets on Saturday at the US Open.

stories.title: Tressel enshrined in Ohio State's ring of honor
stories.summary: Jim Tressel, who coached Ohio State to the 2002 national championship, was enshrined into the Buckeyes' ring of honor on Saturday.

stories.title: LSU leaves ex-pros off roster for Clemson opener
stories.summary: Dae'Quan Wright and Zxavian Harris, who were cleared earlier this week to return to college football after brief stints in the NFL, have not been added to LSU's roster for its season opener against Clemson.
